title: Morphological heterogeneity description enabled early and parallel non-invasive prediction of T-cell proliferation inhibitory potency and growth rate for facilitating donor selection of human mesenchymal stem cells.
summary: The primary article uses image-derived morphological profiles and machine learning to predict mesenchymal-stem-cell T-cell inhibitory potency and growth rate within four days, supporting donor/lot selection.
ai_technology: Models use 32 time-course morphology parameters to classify risky lots and predict growth rate.

evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
